title: The Moment He Realized He Was Totally Screwed
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On May 1, 2023, a deputy in Fond du Lac, WI, attempted to stop a suspicious vehicle. The driver, a convicted felon with a drug-related history, fled at high speed but eventually crashed. After a brief foot chase, the driver was apprehended. A search of the vehicle revealed drug-related items. Based on a witness report, deputies also learned additional drugs were dumped in the area where the driver initially fled which contained roughly 1,000 fentanyl pills.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
